name: thinloop
description: Simplify complex development with Issue-backed discovery, risk-adaptive Web experience and architecture design, non-executing multi-Issue project decomposition into dependency DAGs, autonomous single-Issue PR delivery, evidence-backed maintenance, concise experiential knowledge, and human-approved skill evolution.

interface.shortDescription: Discovery, project DAGs, design, delivery, maintenance, knowledge, and evolution
interface.longDescription: Clarify consequential product decisions into approved delivery contracts, design Web experiences and technical boundaries at the lightest useful fidelity, decompose an approved multi-delivery project into Initiative and Delivery Issues plus a dependency DAG without running an execution loop, keep single-Issue implementation scoped and evidence-backed, verify acceptance through an independent agent, merge eligible pull requests into main, close verified Issues, audit or repair repository drift on request, preserve proven development experience, and evolve used Thinloop skills through human-approved reversible trials.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use SCD Discovery when product decisions are open, SCD UIUX when a Web experience needs design, SCD Architecture when domain, system, or shared interface boundaries need design, SCD Project to decompose an approved multi-delivery outcome into Initiative and Delivery Issues plus a dependency DAG; SCD Project stops at the validated graph and does not run an implementation loop. Use SCD QuickDev for Issue-backed single-delivery implementation through eligible PR merge, SCD Maintenance only when I explicitly ask to audit or repair repository debt, SCD Knowledge only when I explicitly ask to capture or retrieve proven experience, and SCD Evolve only when I explicitly ask to diagnose this interaction and improve a Thinloop skill.
